newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks in London mixed, exporters up.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks in London mixed, exporters up.

text.p: Japanese stocks in London were mixed on Wednesday, with exporting issues led higher by better-than-expected profits by Canon, traders said.
The Nikkei 50 index of leading shares traded in London fell 5.65 points from Tuesday's London close to 1,426.12, after the Tokyo Nikkei 225 index closed some 128.37 points firmer at 18,599.12.
Canon Inc posted a record 94.2 billion yen ($759 million) net profit for 1996, up 71 percent on the previous year.
Other export stocks caught in Canon's wake included Sony, up 15 yen from Tokyo's close, at 8,845 yen.
London followed Tokyo's trends with buying interest in ship-building and steel issues, one trader said.

The London market also saw renewed interest in bank stocks, according to one trader. "We saw a new trend of quite good buying interest in city banks, including the Bank of Tokyo and Mitsubishi Bank," he added.
